My current interests include physics, programming, and emerging technologies.

I am a condensed matter physicist working on experimental cryogenic transport
measurements and thin-film oxide materials. On this site you will find my
[curriculum vitae](cv.qmd) and a collection of [technical notes](notes.qmd)
on topics in physics, mathematics, and scientific computing.
